conditions: The partner must implement an IAB approved consent management platform (CMP)
The partner must ensure that the Outbrain widget can receive and process the consent signal
Consent notices must be adhered to, such as GDPR and CCPA regulations
effects: Outbrain can collect consent and opt-out data from partner sites or applications
Compliance with GDPR and CCPA for data processing
Allows users in California to opt-out of the sale of personal information

conditions: For SDK implementations, the partner must use an up-to-date Outbrain SDK version
For consent management, the configuration must support IAB TCF V2.0 or CCPA
effects: Automatic collection of consent data on most implementations
Honoring user’s choice to opt-out of personal information sales in compliance with CCPA

conditions: If the partner sends a null or invalid consent signal
effects: Outbrain will not be able to process consent correctly
